The tax bench beyond the selected five is thin: remaining candidates rely heavily on treatment, audit behavior, withholding mechanics, generic bookkeeping, or VAT implementation details not established by the routing pass.
coverage_decision: Coverage target retained exactly: five immigration, five company, five tax, and five property recommendations. C04 and C22 are the weakest fifth-domain selections numerically, but remain more season-worthy than their same-domain alternatives after considering overlap, premise deliverability, source routing, and audience breadth. Higher-ranked surplus company and property topics were moved to reserves rather than creating domain imbalance.
curation_summary: The final slate respects deterministic consensus while applying a deliberate immigration-company-property-tax rotation across five cycles. It opens with a broad conceptual orientation, alternates emotional and institutional registers, uses familiar high-intent topics sparingly, and closes with an exit-focused episode. The 20 recommendations, 10 reserves, and 10 rejected candidates are mutually disjoint.
